label: Get Subscription Data
description: Get Information of balances, tiers, rewards and subscription members for a subscription

pid.description: Loyalty Program ID. A unique identifier for the loyalty program.

contactId.description: The contact ID to filter by.

params.description: A list of filter parameters for querying the subscription info.

loyaltySubscriptionId.description: The loyalty subscription ID to filter by.

includeInternal.description: Include balances tied to internal definitions.

balances.description: List of balance details associated with the contact.

balanceDefinitionId.description: Unique identifier for the balance definition).

loyaltyProgramId.description: Unique identifier of the loyalty program.

members.description: List of members associated with the subscription.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the member was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the member was last updated.

membership.description: Membership details of the subscription. Returned when the subscription could be resolved from the provided `contactId` or `loyaltySubscriptionId`.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the subscription was created.

loyaltySubscriptionId.description: Unique identifier of the loyalty subscription.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the subscription was last updated.

reward.description: List of rewards associated with the subscription.

code.description: Reward code assigned to the contact.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the reward was created.

loyaltyProgramId.description: Unique identifier of the loyalty program.

meta.description: Additional metadata related to the reward.

publicDescription.description: Customer-facing description of the reward, as configured on the reward definition.

rewardId.description: Unique identifier of the reward definition.

rewardName.description: Customer-facing name of the reward. Falls back to the internal reward name when no public name is set.

unit.description: Unit the reward's value is expressed in — one of the currency codes listed below, or PERCENT. Omitted when the reward has no unit (e.g. free-product rewards).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the reward was last updated.

validFrom.description: Date from which the voucher becomes valid.

value.description: The value recorded when this reward was attributed to the contact — a snapshot, not necessarily the reward's current configured value. Omitted when not set.

tier.description: List of tier assignments for the subscription.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the tier was assigned.

groupId.description: Unique identifier of the group associated with the tier.

groupName.description: Name of the group associated with the tier.

loyaltyProgramId.description: Unique identifier of the loyalty program.

meta.description: Additional metadata related to the tier.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the tier was last updated

preconditions: Loyalty app activated (needed before any call in this area)

verification.notes: Not run with real inputs. A call with inputs that cannot succeed returned HTTP 422 ({"error": "Invalid loyalty program id"}). This answer does not show whether the free plan allows the action. Evidence: evidence/runs.jsonl#run=probe-gates-1793648157.
